Model Overview (English) BEYOND REALITY Z IMAGE 1.0 is a checkpoint model fine-tuned from the community Z IMAGE model, merging LoRA weights to preserve the signature high-clarity, high-aesthetic quality of the BEYOND REALITY series. We believe: Beauty cannot be defined, only felt.

sources.snippet: Overview BEYOND_REALITY_Z_IMAGE (version 3.0) is a portrait-focused text-to-image diffusion model created by Nurburgring that generates high-fidelity human faces and character photography with film photography aesthetics. Built on the community Z IMAGE architecture with merged LoRA weights, this checkpoint model prioritizes high-frequency texture detail—skin pores, fabric weaves ...
